title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Beyond Solver Verdicts: Generative Reward Models for Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: Neurosymbolic systems rely on mathematical solvers to guarantee reasoning correctness, yet solvers are fundamentally blind to whether a formal translation maintains strict reference-equivalence to a designated formalization. We formalize this vulnerability as Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness (VPU): a failure mode where an incorrect encoding executes successfully and matches the expected verdict. We theoretically prove that structural, verdict-only verification heuristics are mathematically bounded to chance-level detection on these deceptively valid traces. To resolve this, we introduce Generative Verification (GenV), which distills an offline Z3-equivalence oracle into a reference-free, continuous reference-equivalence score by repurposing the language model's native vocabulary space. Mechanistic analysis via decision-projected logit lenses and sparse autoencoders shows this generative readout natively extracts precise spatial error coordinates without explicit localization training. Empirically, our oracle-mined verifier (GenV+HN) achieves 0.961 AUROC in reference-equivalence verification, generalizes zero-shot across unseen translators and divergent formal styles, and yields an 11.3-point downstream accuracy gain in agentic test-time compute allocation.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Generative Verification（GenV），用于检验自动形式化结果是否与指定参考形式化严格等价，而非仅依赖求解器给出的可满足性或判定结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作明确指出“求解器通过”不等于形式化翻译忠实；报告的等价性验证 AUROC 与跨翻译器测试提供了可检查的评测目标，但结果仍来自预印本实验。
items.abstract_zh: 神经符号系统依赖数学求解器来保证推理正确性，但求解器从根本上无法判断一个形式化翻译是否与指定的参考形式化保持严格的参考等价性。我们将这一脆弱性形式化为 Verdict-Preserving-Unfaithfulness（VPU）：一种错误编码能够成功执行且与预期判定结果一致的失败模式。我们从理论上证明，结构性的、仅依据判定结果的验证启发式方法，在这些具有欺骗性但有效的轨迹上，其检测能力在数学上受限于随机猜测水平。为解决这一问题，我们引入 Generative Verification（GenV）：它将离线 Z3 等价性预言机蒸馏为无参考的、连续的参考等价性评分，方法是重新利用语言模型原生的词表空间。通过决策投影 logit lens 和稀疏自编码器进行的机制分析表明，该生成式读出无需显式定位训练，即可原生提取精确的空间错误坐标。实证上，我们的预言机挖掘验证器（GenV+HN）在参考等价性验证中达到 0.961 AUROC，可零样本泛化到未见翻译器和不同形式化风格，并使智能体测试时计算分配的下游准确率提高 11.3 个百分点。
items.author_line: Vikash Singh, Debargha Ganguly, Aman Goel, Ali Torkamani, Xiaoxue Han, Joseph Lilien, Ferhat Erata, Vipin Chaudhary

items.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
items.abstract_or_text: Language models can produce plausible short proofs, but may still be unreliable on long-horizon research problems, where progress depends on a sequence of uncertain and interdependent decisions. We introduce Stellar Colosseum, a model-agnostic harness for allocating inference across research in mathematics and theoretical computer science. Colosseum explores alternative strategies before proof construction, uses a readiness gate to decide when a route is mature enough to decompose, represents the proof plan as interdependent section-level subproblems, and routes verifier findings back to the affected part of the argument. Across these stages, it generates candidates in parallel, attacks them with targeted falsification, and combines candidates and their critiques into a single research artifact through overlapping random-sample tree aggregation. The Colosseum workflow has also been integrated into Google Antigravity's Teamwork framework as the Long Proof pattern. We demonstrate the capabilities of Colosseum through open-ended research and evaluations on theorem-proving and competitive programming benchmarks. Using Colosseum with Gemini 3.1 Pro, we obtain several new results that address open problems arising from papers published at top venues such as FOCS and JMLR. On TCS-Bench, a benchmark of research-level theorem-proving tasks drawn from papers published at FOCS, STOC, and SODA, Colosseum achieves 71.0% accuracy using Gemini 3.1 Pro and Gemini 3.7 Flash. In a separate Codeforces evaluation using Gemini 3.1 Pro, the proof-oriented pipeline with execution feedback solves 218 of 222 problems.
items.summary_zh: Stellar Colosseum 是用于数学与理论计算机科学长程研究的多智能体编排框架，结合策略探索、证明计划分解、反驳和验证反馈回路。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文给出了 TCS-Bench 和 Codeforces 上的具体结果，因而可审阅其流程在既定基准中的表现；不能据此将系统的开放研究产出概括为普遍可靠的数学发现能力。
items.abstract_zh: 语言模型可以生成看似合理的短证明，但在长程研究问题上仍可能不可靠；在此类问题中，进展依赖一系列不确定且相互依赖的决策。我们提出 Stellar Colosseum，这是一个与模型无关的框架，用于在数学和理论计算机科学研究中分配推理资源。Colosseum 在构造证明之前探索替代策略，使用就绪门控来判断一条路线何时成熟到可以分解，将证明计划表示为相互依赖的章节级子问题，并将验证器发现反馈到论证中受影响的部分。在这些阶段中，它并行生成候选方案，以针对性证伪加以攻击，并通过重叠的随机样本树聚合，将候选及其批评整合为单一研究产物。Colosseum 工作流也已作为 Long Proof 模式集成到 Google Antigravity 的 Teamwork 框架中。我们通过开放式研究以及定理证明和竞赛编程基准上的评测展示 Colosseum 的能力。将 Colosseum 与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 结合使用时，我们得到若干新结果，处理了源自 FOCS 和 JMLR 等顶级会议发表论文的开放问题。在由 FOCS、STOC 和 SODA 论文中的研究级定理证明任务构成的 TCS-Bench 上，Colosseum 使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 和 Gemini 3.7 Flash 达到 71.0% 准确率。在另一项使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的 Codeforces 评测中，带有执行反馈的面向证明流水线解决了 222 道题中的 218 道。
items.author_line: Honghao Lin, David P. Woodruff, Yuan Deng, Jieming Mao, Song Zuo, Vahab Mirrokni

items.title: Func-R1: Incentivizing Mathematical Function Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Performing deliberate mathematical reasoning in visual contexts is a hallmark of advanced Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and requires a sophisticated synthesis of perceptual grounding and symbolic logic. However, in the realm of mathematical functions, our investigation reveals a critical modality interference phenomenon: even advanced models, while performing textual computational reasoning, tend to disregard or misinterpret essential visual cues. To address this challenge, we propose Func-R1, which synergistically harmonizes precise visual perception and rigorous logical reasoning. Concretely, built upon an explicitly decoupled architecture, we employ a hierarchical post-training framework to progressively identify critical visual evidence and conduct in-depth theoretical reasoning. Furthermore, the Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization (PATO) strategy is proposed to steer policy updating towards internalizing fundamental theoretical properties while dynamically rectifying heterogeneous visual information throughout the reasoning process. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that Func-R1 delivers the optimal performance among open-source MLLMs, even surpassing GPT-5 with an 8.4% improvement on MathVerse's function-oriented tasks.
items.summary_zh: Func-R1 面向图像中函数题的多模态数学推理，通过解耦架构、分层后训练和 PATO 同时处理视觉证据与理论推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究将任务限定为 MathVerse 的函数相关问题，并报告了相对比较结果；这支持对该特定视觉数学任务的考察，不足以证明模型具备通用数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 在视觉语境中进行审慎的数学推理是高级 Multimodal Large Language Models（MLLMs）的标志，并且需要复杂地综合感知落地和符号逻辑。然而，在数学函数领域，我们的研究揭示了一种关键的模态干扰现象：即使是先进模型在进行文本计算推理时，也倾向于忽略或误解必要的视觉线索。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 Func-R1，使精确视觉感知与严格逻辑推理协同一致。具体而言，基于显式解耦的架构，我们采用分层后训练框架，逐步识别关键视觉证据并进行深入理论推理。此外，我们提出 Perception-Aligned Theoretic Optimization（PATO）策略，引导策略更新内化基础理论性质，同时在推理过程中动态校正异质视觉信息。跨多种基准的大量实验表明，Func-R1 在开源 MLLMs 中表现最佳，甚至在 MathVerse 的函数导向任务上以 8.4% 的提升超过 GPT-5。
items.author_line: Mingze Yin, Xiaohan Wang, Dian Li, Haichao Yao, Yilin Zhao, Youjun Chen, Gang Liu, Jintai Chen, Yiheng Zhu, Chang-Yu Hsieh, Aimin Pan

items.title: Proving olympiad geometry theorems on a superconducting quantum processor
items.abstract_or_text: Automated theorem proving seeks to use computational systems to prove or disprove mathematical and logical statements [1, 2]. It underpins a wide range of applications, and enhancing theorem-proving capabilities remains a central objective in artificial intelligence [3]. Although recent neuro-symbolic systems have achieved remarkable progress [4-7], their operation is ultimately constrained by classical computational architectures. Quantum computing [8], by contrast, enables information encoding and coherent parallelism beyond classical limits [9-14], raising the possibility of accelerating structured symbolic deduction [15]. Here we report the experimental realization of automated geometry theorem proving on a fully programmable superconducting quantum processor. We develop two complementary quantum proving frameworks. The first implements Wu's algebraic elimination method using quantum pseudo-division, with multivariate polynomials represented in superposition states, enabling quantum algebraic theorem proving. The second implements the full-angle method as backward symbolic reasoning through a hybrid quantum strategy-guided architecture, demonstrating a general route toward quantum symbolic proof search. As illustrative examples, we prove two theorems on a superconducting quantum processor: the perpendicularity of the diagonals of a square and a 1978 International Mathematical Olympiad geometry problem. Our results establish, at the experimental level, automated logical reasoning as a viable task for near-term quantum processors and provide a concrete pathway toward quantum-enhanced symbolic intelligence.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在可编程超导量子处理器上演示两种几何定理证明框架，并报告证明正方形对角线垂直及一道 1978 年 IMO 几何题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作提供了明确的硬件实验对象、两种符号推理路线和两个示例定理；其证据支持概念验证，不应外推为量子处理器已普遍加速自动定理证明。
items.abstract_zh: 自动定理证明旨在使用计算系统证明或证伪数学与逻辑陈述 [1, 2]。它支撑广泛的应用，提升定理证明能力仍是人工智能的核心目标 [3]。尽管近期神经符号系统已取得显著进展 [4-7]，其运行最终仍受经典计算架构约束。相比之下，量子计算 [8] 允许超越经典极限的信息编码和相干并行性 [9-14]，因而带来加速结构化符号演绎的可能性 [15]。在此，我们报告了在一台完全可编程超导量子处理器上实现自动几何定理证明的实验。我们开发了两种互补的量子证明框架。第一种使用量子伪除法实现 Wu 的代数消元方法，其中多元多项式以叠加态表示，从而实现量子代数定理证明。第二种将全角法实现为通过混合量子策略引导架构进行的反向符号推理，展示了一条通向量子符号证明搜索的通用途径。作为示例，我们在一台超导量子处理器上证明了两个定理：正方形两条对角线的垂直性，以及一道 1978 年 International Mathematical Olympiad 几何题。我们的结果在实验层面确立了自动逻辑推理作为近期量子处理器可行任务的地位，并为量子增强的符号智能提供了一条具体路径。
items.author_line: Ning Wang, Zheng-Zhi Sun, Zhengyi Cui, Yiren Zou, Aosai Zhang, Fanhao Shen, Jiarun Zhong, Zehang Bao, Zitian Zhu, Han Wang, Jia-Nan Yang, Jiayuan Shen, Gongyu Liu, Yanzhe Wang, Yihang Han, Yiyang He, Jiahua Huang, Sailang Zhou, Xinrong Zhang, Yaozu Wu, Zixuan Song, Jinfeng Deng, Hang Dong, Qi Ye, Weikang Li, Si Jiang, Yixuan Ma, Shuangyue Geng, Zhide Lu, Chao Song, Hekang Li, Pengfei Zhang, Qiujiang Guo, H. Wang, Dong-Ling Deng

items.title: Improving Mathematical Reasoning Capabilities in Large Language Models via Reasoning Process Error Classification
items.abstract_or_text: The reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) is a critical factor for practical LLM-based applications. To investigate the current reasoning capability of LLMs, we clarify the types of errors that arise in LLMs' reasoning processes on mathematical datasets. We focus on problems where LLMs produce an incorrect answer. We define errors in the reasoning process as reasoning errors and manually analyze the features of reasoning errors. We defined and classified 21 error classes and identified the frequently occurring classes among them. Beyond qualitative evaluation, we leverage the evaluation results to improve the reasoning capability. We designed a prompt that explicitly focuses on eight error classes. The experiments demonstrate that this prompt effectively improves reasoning performance. Furthermore, the results suggest that the frequent reasoning errors identified in this paper are common across LLMs of comparable scale.
items.summary_zh: 研究人工标注并归类数学题错误答案中的 21 类推理过程错误，再将其中八类错误写入提示词以测试性能变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把笼统的“推理失败”转为可审阅的错误分类和干预实验；摘要未给出各数据集的具体增益，故只能将其视为诊断与提示设计的初步证据。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力是实际 LLM 应用的关键因素。为考察当前 LLM 的推理能力，我们澄清 LLM 在数学数据集上的推理过程中出现的错误类型。我们聚焦于 LLM 给出错误答案的问题。我们将推理过程中的错误定义为推理错误，并人工分析推理错误的特征。我们定义并分类了 21 个错误类别，并识别出其中频繁出现的类别。除定性评估外，我们还利用评估结果提升推理能力。我们设计了一个显式聚焦于八类错误的提示词。实验表明，该提示词能有效提升推理性能。此外，结果表明，本文识别出的高频推理错误在规模相近的 LLM 之间具有共性。
items.author_line: Runa Yoshida, Kosuke Nishida, Kyosuke Nishida

items.title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly asked to reason over structured data such as graphs, yet how reliably they can carry out multi-step graph algorithms in language remains unclear. Existing evaluations tend to use simple tasks on small graphs, to score code generation rather than reasoning over the graph itself, or to fix a single input format. We introduce Graph Theory Bench (GT Bench), a benchmark covering 24 classical graph problems in 44 task-structure settings, with over 100,000 examples across four representations: natural language, structured language, adjacency list, and adjacency matrix. Evaluating eight LLMs on GT Bench shows that accuracy is strongly tied to the input representation, that the best representation shifts with graph density, size, and topology as well as with the model, and that this sensitivity persists, attenuated, in the strongest reasoning models. Building on these observations, we propose the Graph Theory Agent (GTA), which pairs a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding around a frozen executor LLM. GTA lifts Phi-4 from 53.5% to 69.1% on the benchmark's easy split and from 33.0% to 41.5% on its hard split, outperforming eight prompting and agent baselines, and transfers without retraining to GraCoRe and NLGraph. Code for benchmark generation and evaluation: https://github.com/xzx34/GTA. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/gta/.
items.summary_zh: GTA 同时发布 GT Bench 和图论智能体：基准覆盖 24 个经典图问题、44 种任务—结构设置及四种输入表示，智能体学习选择表示并分解计划。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 图论任务、难度划分、模型比较及迁移测试均被明确说明，适合检查语言模型对图算法推理的表示依赖；报告的提升限于所述基准与执行器设置。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被要求对图这类结构化数据进行推理，但它们能否可靠地以语言执行多步图算法仍不清楚。现有评测往往在小图上使用简单任务，评分代码生成而非对图本身的推理，或固定单一输入格式。我们提出 Graph Theory Bench（GT Bench），该基准覆盖 24 个经典图问题、44 种任务—结构设置，以及四种表示形式中的超过 100,000 个样本：自然语言、结构化语言、邻接表和邻接矩阵。用 GT Bench 评估八个 LLM 表明，准确率与输入表示强相关；最佳表示会随图密度、规模、拓扑和模型而变化，并且这种敏感性在最强推理模型中依然存在，只是有所减弱。基于这些观察，我们提出 Graph Theory Agent（GTA），它将一个经偏好训练的表示选择器与围绕冻结执行器 LLM 的计划—分解脚手架结合起来。GTA 将 Phi-4 在基准简单划分上的成绩从 53.5% 提升到 69.1%，在困难划分上从 33.0% 提升到 41.5%，优于八种提示和智能体基线，并且无需再训练即可迁移到 GraCoRe 和 NLGraph。基准生成与评测代码见：https://github.com/xzx34/GTA。项目主页见：https://xzx34.github.io/gta/。
items.author_line: Zixiang Xu, Yanbo Wang, Chenxi Wang, Lang Gao, Zirui Song, Yue Huang, Zhaorun Chen, Xiangliang Zhang, Xiuying Chen

items.title: Can LLMs Normalize Databases? A Benchmark and Multi-Agent Framework for Schema Normalization
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured outputs, but their reliability remains unclear when those outputs must satisfy database-level constraints. We study this issue through database normalization, involving reasoning about functional dependencies, lossless join decompositions, and inter-table constraints. We introduce a Database Normalization Benchmark (DNBENCH), comprising 3,275 samples for evaluating LLM-driven database normalization from 1NF to BCNF. DNBENCH uses a three-axis protocol to measure semantic equivalence, structural accuracy, and logical validity. Across Single, Complex, and Real World levels, DNBENCH uncovers recurring failures in dependency inference, schema decomposition, and inter-table constraint reconstruction. We further propose Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas (MARS), which separates evidence extraction, violation diagnosis, and decomposition planning from schema generation and verification. MARS improves the DNB-SCORE by 82.0% over the single-prompt baseline. All artifacts will be released upon acceptance.
items.summary_zh: DNBENCH 用 3,275 个样本评估从 1NF 到 BCNF 的数据库规范化，并以语义等价、结构准确和逻辑有效性三轴检查输出；MARS 将证据、诊断、规划与生成验证分工。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据库规范化包含函数依赖与无损分解等可形式化约束，三轴协议使模型输出不只按文本相似度评分；全部制品尚待接收后发布，复现条件仍有限。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）日益用于生成结构化输出，但当这些输出必须满足数据库层面的约束时，其可靠性仍不清楚。我们通过数据库规范化研究此问题，其中涉及对函数依赖、无损连接分解和表间约束的推理。我们提出 Database Normalization Benchmark（DNBENCH），其中包含 3,275 个样本，用于评估由 LLM 驱动的、从 1NF 到 BCNF 的数据库规范化。DNBENCH 使用三轴协议测量语义等价性、结构准确性和逻辑有效性。跨越 Single、Complex 和 Real World 层级，DNBENCH 揭示了依赖推断、模式分解和表间约束重构中反复出现的失败。我们还提出 Multi-Agent Reasoning for Schemas（MARS），它将证据提取、违例诊断和分解规划，与模式生成和验证分离。MARS 相比单提示基线将 DNB-SCORE 提升 82.0%。所有制品将在接收后发布。
items.author_line: Dong-Jae Koh, Huisu Kim, SeongHwan Yoon, Lasse M. Jantsch, Chun-Hee Lee, Seonghyeon Lee, Young-Kyoon Suh

items.title: TimeThink: Eliciting Compositional Reasoning in Timeseries Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Timeseries multimodal large language models (TS-MLLMs) have recently begun leveraging the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) for question-answering tasks. However, these models often fail to capture dynamic temporal patterns, providing only implicit reasoning that lacks the underlying explanations critical for high-stakes applications like healthcare. While reinforcement learning (RL)-based timeseries language models aim to address this, they often fall short because they are trained on narrow, in-distribution data and struggle with out-of-distribution compositional questions. To address these challenges, we present TimeThink, a synthetic framework for eliciting compositional timeseries reasoning. Core timeseries primitives (e.g., trend, seasonality) are domain-independent and can be deterministically generated. Guided by this premise, TimeThink first designs a synthetic data generator that produces atomic and composite question-answer pairs, providing objective ground truth with reasoning traces. Building on this framework, TimeThink employs a reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) training strategy that encourages explicit reasoning. Unlike template-reliant methods, this approach enables the model to learn the underlying logic of composition rather than simply imitating traces. Extensive experiments show that TimeThink, trained only on synthetic data, significantly outperforms strong baselines on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
items.summary_zh: TimeThink 从可确定生成的趋势、季节性等时间序列原语构造带推理轨迹的原子与组合问题，并以 RLVR 训练显式组合推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 合成生成器可提供客观真值和推理轨迹，且论文同时报告真实基准测试；这使组合时间序列推理可被分解评估，但不等同于高风险时间序列应用中的可靠解释。
items.abstract_zh: 时间序列多模态大语言模型（TS-MLLMs）近来开始利用大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力完成问答任务。然而，这些模型常常无法捕捉动态时间模式，只提供缺乏底层解释的隐式推理；而这种解释对于医疗等高风险应用至关重要。尽管基于强化学习（RL）的时间序列语言模型旨在解决这一问题，但它们常因在狭窄的、分布内数据上训练而不足，并且难以处理分布外组合问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TimeThink，这是一个用于引出组合性时间序列推理的合成框架。核心时间序列原语（例如趋势、季节性）与领域无关，并可确定性生成。基于这一前提，TimeThink 首先设计一个合成数据生成器，产生原子和组合的问答对，并提供具有推理轨迹的客观真值。在此框架上，TimeThink 采用具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练策略，鼓励显式推理。与依赖模板的方法不同，该方法使模型能够学习组合的底层逻辑，而非仅模仿轨迹。大量实验表明，仅使用合成数据训练的 TimeThink，在合成和真实世界基准上均显著优于强基线。
items.author_line: Sudarshan Regmi, Arvind Pillai, Yu Yvonne Wu, Yuliang Chen, Bibek Panthi, Tess Z. Griffin, Michael V. Heinz, Lisa Marsch, Nicholas C. Jacobson, Andrew Campbell

items.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). We introduce Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free method derived from Policy Mirror Descent (PMD). For autoregressive generation with terminal rewards, BPO uses the Bellman equations to reformulate PMD as a trajectory-level objective. The reformulation avoids estimating state values at intermediate states. We prove that it has the same unique optimal solution as the original PMD objective. We derive the practical BPO loss by approximating this objective. Its mismatch-correction weight is a smoothed ratio of complementary token probabilities. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of BPO.
items.summary_zh: Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO）从 Policy Mirror Descent 推导无 critic 的轨迹级目标，并证明该目标与原始 PMD 目标具有相同的唯一最优解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作同时给出优化目标的明确理论命题和数学推理基准实验，是区分训练目标性质与经验效果的可审阅对象；摘要没有提供完整的逐基准数值。
items.abstract_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够提升大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力。我们提出 Bellman Policy Optimization（BPO），一种从 Policy Mirror Descent（PMD）推导出的无 critic 方法。对于具有终端奖励的自回归生成，BPO 使用 Bellman 方程将 PMD 重写为轨迹级目标。该重写避免在中间状态估计状态价值。我们证明，它与原始 PMD 目标具有相同的唯一最优解。我们通过近似这一目标推导出实用的 BPO 损失。其失配校正权重是互补 token 概率的平滑比率。数学推理基准上的实验展示了 BPO 的有效性。
items.author_line: Zhuoqing Song, Haotian Xu, Xikun Zhang, Lidong Bing

items.title: AlgoEvo: Self-Evolving Agentic Search for Automated Algorithm Discovery
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models have advanced automated algorithm discovery by synthesizing executable code, but existing frameworks trap them in rigid search pipelines with pre-defined control flows. This limitation restricts adaptive reasoning, blocks cross-paradigm transfer, and discards valuable execution feedback. We propose AlgoEvo, a unified agentic framework that transforms automated algorithm discovery into an interactive, knowledge-accumulating process. An autonomous agent dynamically inspects, diagnoses, and edits code based on runtime feedback. A design skill hub decouples paradigm-specific knowledge from the core discovery engine, allowing a single workflow to seamlessly handle single-objective, multi-objective, and multi-component design. Meanwhile, a hierarchical experience mechanism organizes search trajectories into a task-level tree to guide exploration and consolidates cross-task patterns into reusable skills. Across six representative benchmark tasks, AlgoEvo matches or surpasses specialized methods with substantially fewer evaluations and reduced token consumption, demonstrating strong intra-task accumulation, cross-task transfer, and the ability to reproduce or exceed existing state-of-the-art performance through flexible skill activation.
items.summary_zh: AlgoEvo 将算法发现建模为利用运行时反馈进行代码检查、诊断与编辑的智能体搜索，并以层级经验和技能库跨任务积累设计知识。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文在六项基准任务上比较专用方法，考察评估次数、token 消耗与性能；其结果主要支持自动算法搜索流程，而非对生成算法的普遍最优性保证。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型已通过合成可执行代码推进自动算法发现，但现有框架将其困在具有预定义控制流的刚性搜索流水线中。这一限制约束了自适应推理，阻碍跨范式迁移，并丢弃宝贵的执行反馈。我们提出 AlgoEvo，一个统一的智能体框架，将自动算法发现转化为交互式、知识累积的过程。自主智能体根据运行时反馈动态检查、诊断和编辑代码。设计技能中心将特定范式知识从核心发现引擎中解耦，使单一工作流能够无缝处理单目标、多目标和多组件设计。同时，分层经验机制将搜索轨迹组织为任务级树，以引导探索，并将跨任务模式整合为可复用技能。跨六个代表性基准任务，AlgoEvo 以显著更少的评估次数和更低的 token 消耗，达到或超过专用方法，展示了强大的任务内累积、跨任务迁移，以及通过灵活技能激活复现或超过已有最先进性能的能力。
items.author_line: Junhao Qiu, Qinglong Hu, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan, Liyong Lin, Qingfu Zhang

items.title: SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery
items.abstract_or_text: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. Exact objective-value agreement ranges from 27.0% to 87.6% across datasets, with 1.4--5.7 questions per instance on average. These results establish feasibility under controlled branch-and-reveal feedback; they do not measure performance with human users or general structural model repair. Code is available at: https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR.
items.summary_zh: SAILOR 用求解器信息定位自然语言优化描述中缺失且不受支持的数值假设，向用户提出针对性问题后更新模型并求解。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 1,723 个经掩蔽基准实例以及精确目标值一致性提供了清晰评测；作者明确限定为理想化真值反馈，尚未验证真实用户交互或一般结构修复。
items.abstract_zh: 优化问题的自然语言描述可能不完整，或对求解器所需的数值信息含糊不清，包括成本、容量、需求、边界和惩罚。语言模型可以将描述翻译为代码，但当所需数值缺失时，它必须停止或猜测。我们提出 SAILOR，这是一个概念验证系统，能够检测这类缺乏支持的数值选择，向用户提出有针对性的后续问题，并在返回解之前更新优化模型。问题按不确定性以及从求解器导出的、每个缺失值对当前模型影响程度的估计来排序。我们在来自七个掩蔽基准的 1,723 个实例上，用返回真值的理想化模拟器评估该流水线。各数据集上的精确目标值一致性范围为 27.0% 至 87.6%，每个实例平均提出 1.4 至 5.7 个问题。这些结果在受控的分支—揭示反馈下确立了可行性；它们不衡量与人类用户交互时的性能，也不衡量一般结构模型修复。代码见：https://github.com/sshaghayeghs/SAILOR。
items.author_line: Shaghayegh Sadeghi, Stephen L. Smith, David C. Del Rey Fern'andez

items.title: CanvasAnneal: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer promising parallel generation capabilities but lag behind autoregressive models in complex reasoning and tool-use tasks. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has recently been applied to enhance DLMs, standard RL approaches suffer from an exploration bottleneck. To address this, we inject reasoning priors from a stronger teacher model to guide RL exploration. In this paper, we introduce CanvasAnneal, a curriculum-guided diffusion RL framework. During the initial RL phase, we warm-start exploration by injecting teacher-generated reasoning traces into the initial diffusion canvas. As training progresses, we gradually remove this guidance and require the model to generate more of the reasoning trajectory independently. Across mathematical reasoning and tool-use benchmarks, CanvasAnneal improves over standard diffu-GRPO on MATH500, Countdown, and Tau2 and substantially accelerates reward improvement on several tasks, while gains are task-dependent. Our results suggest that structured training-time guidance can alleviate exploration bottlenecks in diffusion RL and speed up convergence on harder tasks.
items.summary_zh: CanvasAnneal 为 Diffusion Language Models 设计课程式强化学习：训练初期注入教师推理轨迹，随后逐步撤去引导，测试 MATH500、Countdown 和工具使用任务。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其主张被限定在与 diffu-GRPO 的指定基准比较，并承认增益随任务而变；因此可作为扩散语言模型推理训练的实验性证据，而非能力的普遍结论。
items.abstract_zh: Diffusion Language Models（DLMs）具有很有前景的并行生成能力，但在复杂推理和工具使用任务上落后于自回归模型。尽管最近已将强化学习（RL）应用于提升 DLMs，标准 RL 方法仍遭遇探索瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们从更强的教师模型注入推理先验以引导 RL 探索。本文提出 CanvasAnneal，一种课程引导的扩散 RL 框架。在初始 RL 阶段，我们将教师生成的推理轨迹注入初始扩散画布，从而为探索热启动。随着训练推进，我们逐渐移除该引导，并要求模型独立生成更多推理轨迹。在数学推理和工具使用基准上，CanvasAnneal 在 MATH500、Countdown 和 Tau2 上优于标准 diffu-GRPO，并在若干任务上显著加快奖励提升，尽管增益依赖于任务。我们的结果表明，结构化的训练时引导可缓解扩散 RL 的探索瓶颈，并加快更困难任务上的收敛。
items.author_line: Blake Olson, Yuhang Song, Emmett McQuinn, Yuan Shangguan

items.title: CausalArena: Benchmarking Causal Discovery in the Foundation Model Era
items.abstract_or_text: Causal discovery aims to uncover causal structures from data and is fundamental to scientific reasoning and intervention-based decision making. Its evaluation relies heavily on structural causal models (SCMs), which specify a causal graph together with the mechanisms that generate data, yet existing studies differ substantially in graph families, mechanisms, and evaluation protocols. The emergence of causal discovery foundation models (CDFMs) further complicates evaluation: performance may reflect not only causal discovery ability, but also overlap between pretraining environments and test SCMs, making results on fixed synthetic benchmarks difficult to interpret. We introduce CausalArena, a unified and evolvable benchmark for causal discovery under a common protocol. Synthetic SCMs supply controlled breadth over structures and mechanisms; semantic operational SCMs provide human-auditable, semantically grounded environments beyond standard synthetic generators; and formula-grounded SCMs test discovery under explicit scientific mechanisms. Public real-world datasets provide an additional external-validity check. Experiments across classical, neural, and pretrained methods reveal substantial ranking shifts across SCM families and protocols, showing that strong performance in one benchmark regime does not reliably transfer to others. These results highlight benchmark diversity and pretraining--evaluation overlap as central challenges for evaluating causal discovery in the foundation model era.
items.summary_zh: CausalArena 为因果发现建立统一且可扩展的评测协议，结合合成 SCM、语义操作 SCM、公式驱动 SCM 与公开真实数据，以考察不同评测族之间的排序变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 因果结构识别可在明确的结构因果模型下测量。该基准特别检验预训练环境与测试环境重叠造成的解释风险，避免将单一合成基准排名直接当作通用因果发现能力。
items.abstract_zh: 因果发现旨在从数据中揭示因果结构，是科学推理和基于干预决策的基础。其评估高度依赖结构因果模型（SCMs）；SCM 同时指定因果图和生成数据的机制，但现有研究在图族、机制和评估协议上差异很大。因果发现基础模型（CDFMs）的出现进一步复杂化了评估：性能可能不仅反映因果发现能力，也反映预训练环境与测试 SCM 的重叠，使固定合成基准上的结果难以解释。我们提出 CausalArena，这是一个在共同协议下评测因果发现的统一且可演进基准。合成 SCM 在结构和机制上提供受控的广度；语义操作 SCM 提供超出标准合成生成器、可由人审计且具语义落地的环境；公式驱动 SCM 则在明确科学机制下测试发现。公开真实世界数据集提供额外的外部有效性检查。对经典、神经和预训练方法的实验揭示，不同 SCM 族和协议之间存在显著的排名变化，表明在一种基准体制中的强性能并不能可靠地迁移到其他体制。这些结果凸显了基准多样性以及预训练—评测重叠，是基础模型时代评估因果发现的核心挑战。
items.author_line: Zi-Rong Li, Si-Yang Liu, Tian-Zuo Wang, Han-Jia Ye

review.note: 从 60 项公开预印本候选中选出 13 项。优先保留具有明确数学/形式化任务、可描述评测设置或定理性结论的工作；未将缺少可检验结果的泛化能力宣称纳入。
